newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE-Uralsyvazinform H1 Russia net 127 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Uralsyvazinform H1 Russia net 127 bln rbls.

text.p: NOTES -- Full company name is OAO Uralsvyazinform.
These figures are prepared to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis.

Financial director Alexander Vokhmin said debtors for the first half of 1997 were 199.93 billion roubles and creditors were 100.41 billion roubles. He did not give comparative figures for the first half of 1996.
Vokhmin also said the board would vote on paying dividends for the second half of 1997 at its forthcoming meeting.

Telecoms holding company Svyazinvest owns a controlling 51 percent stake in Uralsvyazinform, management owns 12 percent of shares, employees own 28.8 percent, and private shareholders own 8.2 percent.
Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble. Inflation was 14.5 percent for the year ending in June 1997.
